rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for something false, fake, or made up.

example.english: This is a make-up story, not a real one.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 hai6 gaa2 ge3

rows.note: Choose this when the made-up thing is an invented story, character, or imaginary situation rather than simply a fake object.

example.english: This character is a make-up character from the novel.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 hai6 heoi1 kau3 ge3
